part_evidence.limits: Do not create symmetric pair or an extra huge finger; maintain the unequal two-process structure.

part_evidence.source: Conservative shell geometry, no exact thickness measurement

required_features: Conical stepped spiral body with noticeably expanded final whorl; preserve original879 compact-body versus projecting-lip contrast.
Attached wing continuous with body, not disconnected fin. Posterior process bends upward nearly parallel to centralspire, anterior process shorter.
Concave wing exterior edge between unequal processes; deep posterior sinus where wing rises away from main shell.
Two broad keels extend toward corresponding wing processes; no arbitrary many spikes.
Primary silhouette 272 Fig17 with missing upper wing process interpreted from302 Fig16 only. Preserve cf.gregaria and reconstruction label.
No elaborate microtexture: outer layer absent in source specimens. Muted fossil color is artistic, not measured.
